data.body_html:
Feria San Bernabé 2050 turns Marbella into a week-long fiesta of flamenco, casetas, and carnival rides from 7 to 14 June. While the fairground buzzes with tradition, the real party for many visitors happens on the water. A marbella boat rental feria san bernabe 2050 charter lets you swap the crowded promenade for a private deck, cold cava in hand, with the Costa del Sol coastline as your backdrop. Departing from Puerto Banús just minutes from the fair, our fleet offers everything from nimble speedboats to 29-metre superyachts.

Why choose a boat party during Feria San Bernabé?

The Feria is a sensory overload — music, dancing, and crowds from midday to midnight. A boat party gives you a cool escape without leaving the celebration behind. You can anchor off Cala del Faro for a swim, cruise past the Golden Mile, or toast the sunset with views of La Concha mountain. With a licensed skipper at the helm, you're free to relax. Every charter includes fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT, so there are no hidden costs.

Our boats for Feria week

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, a 10-minute taxi ride from the Feria fairground. Here's what's available for your group:

For smaller groups, the Mariah SX21 (5 pax) or Dubhe (5 pax) are perfect for an intimate sunset cruise. For larger parties, the Mangusta 80s offer space and a free jet ski — ideal for adrenaline after the fair.

What's included in every charter

  • Licensed, experienced skipper
  • Fuel for the entire charter
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) — no surprises

You can also request a custom catering menu, a DJ, or decorations for a Feria-themed party — just ask via WhatsApp when booking.

Sample Feria boat party itinerary

Most Feria charters start at 16:00 or 18:00, after the daytime fair activities. A typical 4-hour trip:

  1. Depart Puerto Banús, head east towards Marbella Marina
  2. Anchor at Cala del Faro for swimming and paddleboarding (if available)
  3. Cruise past the Golden Mile, spotting villas and yachts
  4. Return to Puerto Banús as the sun sets, with cava in hand

Longer 8-hour charters can extend to Cabopino or Estepona, with a lunch stop at a chiringuito.

How to book your Feria boat rental

Booking is simple: head to our [Marbella boat rental hub](/), choose your boat, and send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date and time. We'll confirm availability and send a booking link for the deposit. With Feria being one of the busiest weeks of the year, we recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks in advance.

Frequently asked questions

How far is Puerto Banús from the Feria San Bernabé fairground?

Puerto Banús is roughly 10 minutes by taxi or 20 minutes' walk from the Feria de San Bernabé fairground, located near the fairgrounds on Avenida del Deporte. Most guests take a short cab ride after the daytime fair activities to start their boat party in the afternoon or evening.

Can we bring our own food and drinks on the boat?

Our standard charters include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. You're welcome to bring additional food or specialty drinks, but we ask that you avoid glass bottles for safety. The skipper will provide coolers and ice to keep everything chilled.

What happens if it rains during Feria San Bernabé 2050?

June in Marbella typically sees 25–30°C and minimal rain, but if the forecast looks poor, we offer free rescheduling to another day within the Feria week, subject to availability. If the skipper deems conditions unsafe, the charter is rescheduled or fully refunded.

Are there any age restrictions for a boat party?

All passengers must be at least 6 years old for safety reasons. For groups with children, we recommend boats with higher freeboard like the Azimut 58 or Ferretti 94. Life jackets are provided for all ages, and the skipper will brief everyone on safety before departure.

Can we swim and use a jet ski during the charter?

Yes, swimming is allowed at designated anchor spots like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, depending on sea conditions. For the Mangusta 80 charters, a jet ski is included free for 4+ hour bookings. On other boats, jet ski rental can be arranged on request via WhatsApp.

How do we book and pay for a Feria boat party?

Booking is done via WhatsApp on our website. We'll confirm availability for your chosen date and boat, then take a 30% deposit to secure the booking. The balance is due 48 hours before departure. We accept bank transfer, credit card, or cash in euros.

What is the cancellation policy for Feria week?

Cancellations made more than 14 days before the charter receive a full refund. Between 7 and 14 days, we retain 30% of the deposit. Within 7 days, the deposit is non-refundable. Weather-related cancellations are always fully refunded or rescheduled.

Make your Feria unforgettable

Don't settle for a crowded caseta when you can have your own floating party. Whether it's a family afternoon or a group celebration, our boats offer the best view of Marbella's coastline during Feria San Bernabé 2050. Check availability for your dates on our [boat rental page](/), or send us a WhatsApp message to start planning. The sea is waiting.
